prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sandy Giza plateau with the great pyramids behind her, a smooth flat sand path and a standard-height stone doorway block at her side, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Brazilian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome young man's idol face with a clean sharp jawline, straight thick brows and defined expressive eyes, a very faint trace of stubble, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth warm bronze skin, a relaxed half-smile, vivid copper-orange hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver round bell, an iron square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum anklets. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
